SELECT users.id, users.email, users.full_name, users.city, users.country, users.status, users.created_at, users.updated_at 
FROM users 
WHERE (users.full_name ILIKE '%' || $1::VARCHAR || '%' ESCAPE '/') AND lower(users.city) = $2::VARCHAR AND users.status = $3 ORDER BY users.id 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER OFFSET $5::INTEGER

SELECT users.id, users.email, users.full_name, users.city, users.country, users.status, users.created_at, users.updated_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = $1::BIGINT

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at, orders.updated_at 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.user_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER OFFSET $3::INTEGER

SELECT order_items.id, order_items.order_id, order_items.product_id, order_items.quantity, order_items.unit_price 
FROM order_items 
WHERE order_items.order_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY order_items.id

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at, orders.updated_at 
FROM orders 
WHERE CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) >= $1::DATE AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) <= $2::DATE AND orders.status = $3 ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER OFFSET $5::INTEGER

SELECT orders.id, orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.total_amount, orders.created_at, orders.updated_at 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.id = $1::BIGINT

SELECT order_items.id, order_items.order_id, order_items.product_id, order_items.quantity, order_items.unit_price 
FROM order_items 
WHERE order_items.order_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY order_items.id

SELECT payments.id, payments.order_id, payments.status, payments.amount, payments.paid_at, payments.created_at 
FROM payments 
WHERE payments.order_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY payments.id

SELECT CAST(date_trunc($1::VARCHAR, orders.created_at) AS DATE) AS period, count(*) AS order_count, sum(orders.total_amount) AS revenue 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.status IN ($4, $5, $6) AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) >= $2::DATE AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) <= $3::DATE GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc($1::VARCHAR, orders.created_at) AS DATE) ORDER BY period

SELECT products.id AS product_id, products.name, sum(order_items.quantity) AS units_sold, sum(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price) AS revenue 
FROM products JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = products.id JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id 
WHERE orders.status IN ($4, $5, $6) AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) >= $1::DATE AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) <= $2::DATE GROUP BY products.id, products.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, revenue DESC, products.id 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER

SELECT count(*) AS total_customers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE anon_1.order_count > $1::INTEGER) AS customers_with_orders, count(*) FILTER (WHERE anon_1.order_count > $2::INTEGER) AS repeat_customers, coalesce(sum(anon_1.order_count), $3::INTEGER) AS order_count, coalesce(sum(anon_1.revenue), $4::INTEGER) AS revenue 
FROM (SELECT users.id AS id, count(orders.id) AS order_count, coalesce(sum(orders.total_amount), $5::INTEGER) AS revenue 
FROM users LEFT OUTER JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id AND orders.status IN ($8, $9, $10) AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) >= $6::DATE AND CAST(orders.created_at AS DATE) <= $7::DATE GROUP BY users.id) AS anon_1

SELECT user_events.id, user_events.user_id, user_events.event_type, user_events.payload, user_events.created_at 
FROM user_events 
WHERE user_events.user_id = $1::BIGINT AND user_events.event_type = $2::VARCHAR ORDER BY user_events.created_at DESC, user_events.id DESC 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER OFFSET $4::INTEGER
